PageAgent - The GUI Agent Living in Your Webpage

name: Page Agent
summary: In-page JavaScript GUI agent: one script gives any web page an AI copilot that controls its interface with natural language.
description: A client-side library that runs an agent inside your web page — no browser extension, python or headless browser, and no screenshots or multimodal model: it reads and manipulates the DOM as text, so mainstream or locally deployed LLMs work (bring your own LLM). Use cases: SaaS AI copilots, smart form filling in ERP/CRM/admin systems, accessibility through natural language, multi-page tasks via an optional Chrome extension, and a beta MCP server. Built on browser-use; MIT licensed.
contains: one script (CDN) or npm install adds an agent to any page; no extension, python or headless browser
text-based DOM manipulation: no screenshots or multimodal models needed
bring your own LLM, including locally deployed models
use cases: SaaS AI copilot, smart form filling, accessibility, multi-page agent, MCP
optional Chrome extension for tasks across browser tabs; MCP server in beta
acknowledges browser-use as its foundation; built for client-side, not server-side, automation
MIT licensed; 29.4k GitHub stars; demo and docs at alibaba.github.io/page-agent
